fusions.name: Drag Under
fusions.desc: Clamps your beak on an enemy at or below 30% health and rolls, which deals 20 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The target is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Log That Wasn't
fusions.desc: Erupts around you, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles as a critical hit and leaves each [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggling Lure
fusions.desc: Up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles are pulled onto you for 5 seconds, and your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Longer the Wait
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
